name: Boku no Shiawase ≠ Kanojo no Shiawase
source:
Normal, run-of-the-mill salaryman Tadashi and his wife Yahiro are happily married.

Well, they were, until Yahiro told him about an ex of hers. Now he's suspicious that she's having an affair. But right as his worries started to boil over, his work handed him a huge new assignment -- meeting with the young CEO of one of their closest business partners!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ336042.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
普通的工薪族正和妻子八寻婚姻幸福。

好吧，他们确实是这样，直到八寻告诉他她的前任。现在他怀疑她有外遇。但正当他的担忧开始沸腾时，他的工作交给了他一项艰巨的新任务——与他们最亲密的商业伙伴之一的年轻首席执行官会面！

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ336042.html]DLsite[/url]]
